character_anchors.prompt_summary: Anthropomorphic orange-yellow cartoon calf standing on two legs, reaching only waist-high compared to an adult bull. He has an oversized rounded head, massive glossy black expressive eyes, a wide damp pinkish muzzle, floppy cream-tipped bovine ears, and two stubby grey horn nubs. He wears faded denim dungarees with brass buckles over his compact, chubby torso. Smooth stylized matte skin without realistic fur detailing.

Burly anthropomorphic orange-brown bull standing tall on two legs with a massive barrel chest and heavy squared jaw. He has a permanently furrowed brow and two long sweeping curved ivory horns with dark tips atop his broad head. He wears a weathered brown leather vest over an unbuttoned tan plaid shirt with sturdy work trousers. His silhouette is heavy, solid, and upright with calm, unmoving posture.

Slender, chopstick-thin milky-white cartoon snake with smooth porcelain-like skin. It has tiny beady black dot eyes and a rounded, gentle snout without visible nostrils or scales. Its lower body coils tightly into a spring-like helical base that allows it to stand stiffly upright like a clean exclamation mark.

Palm-sized bright scarlet cartoon songbird with a sleek teardrop body and a long pointed yellow dagger beak. It features round glossy black eyes with white ring accents and twin slender ribbon-like tail feathers trailing behind. The plumage is clean, solid red with stylized geometric wing feathers.

location_anchors.prompt_summary: Sunlit grassy slope bordering a dense pine woodland under a clear azure sky. The scene is anchored by a massive lichen-speckled grey granite boulder resting firmly in the soil. Surrounding the rock are lush patches of green clover, flowering yellow dandelions, and tall grass blades catching warm afternoon sun.

Sun-dappled woodland clearing bisected by a shallow bubbling creek with smooth river pebbles and sparkling water. On the far mossy bank stands a massive ancient gnarled oak tree with sprawling surface roots and a thick leafy green canopy. Surrounding trees include slender pines and white birches with soft patches of forest moss on damp earth.
